# **About The Modpack**

Mundo Mods Reforged is inspired by the Mundo Mods series by ArticKraft.

ArticKraft - also known as Nil Civis - released multiple seasons of Mundo Mods on his YouTube channel, combining exploration, creativity, and a wide variety of mods while         staying true to Minecraft’s vanilla style.

https://www.youtube.com/ArticKraft

Over the years, I rewatched all of those series and felt their charisma once again. It has been my favorite Minecraft series ever since I discovered it, and that is why I created Mundo Mods Reforged a modern reinterpretation of that experience, adapted for current Minecraft versions.

# **Features:**

- Utility and quality-of-life mods that preserve the essence of Minecraft (interface, visuals, exploration, decoration, & more)
- Enhanced world generation (improved terrain, structures, and dungeons)
- Technology & automation
- Tool progression mods
- Magic-themed mods
- Performance mods
- ArticKraft's favorite shaders (BSL shaders) & complementary shaders have also been added.

For RAM allocation, configure it so that it is free for other processes on your PC/Mac; ​​4-6 GB minimum, if you have 16 GB or more, allocate 8GB
